name: Siglap Fringe
summary: Edges of Siglap toward Marine Parade / Bedok — east-coast adjacent living with quieter residential texture and ActiveSG catchment.
body: Siglap Fringe is the shortlist when east-coast adjacency and quieter residential texture matter more than CBD skyline premiums. The pocket sits on the Siglap / Marine Parade / Bedok edges; housing mixes mid-age condos, walk-ups, and selective HDB. Expats land here for car-light hops to town and ActiveSG circuit / track catchment without Orchard rents. Watch-outs: LPS / earth-pit inspection notices on mid-rises, weekend cafe crowds on some strips, and confusing Siglap vs Siglap Fringe shortlists. Compare with Frankel East for denser landed-edge living, Opera Estate West for quieter estate texture, and Eunos North when EWL food density wins.
